sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen-Image-2.1: Qwen's most powerful open-source image ...
sources.snippet: We are excited to open-source Qwen-Image-2.1, a unified text-to-image generation and image editing model in the Qwen family. With just 7B parameters in its visual generation component (32 Single-Stream DiT layers), Qwen-Image-2.1 balances generation quality, inference efficiency, and versatility. Four key improvements define this release: Compact and Efficient — A lightweight architecture ...

sources.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo · Models
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is an accelerated checkpoint of Qwen-Image-2.1 for text-to-image generation and image editing with 8 denoising steps. It uses the same 7B visual generation architecture and loads directly with QwenImage21Pipeline in Diffusers.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio:qwen-image-2.1-turbo
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is the most balanced and cost-effective open-source image generation model currently available in the Qwen-Image series. Qwen-Image-2.1 offers four key strengths: Compact Model, Strong Performance, Exceptional Value.
